payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Comparing source and edited images, is there clear evidence that the requested mug-to-right arrangement was newly achieved or that the mug made progress toward it?
node.criteria: Pass only if comparison establishes that the requested mug-to-right relation is newly achieved, or that the mug moved toward the right-side relation but remains short of it. Fail only if comparison clearly establishes no progress toward that relation. Unknown if the comparison cannot distinguish a changed arrangement from a pre-existing right-side mug, or cannot establish progress or its absence. Do not require exact visual identity when other clear comparative evidence establishes the requested change; do not treat a right-side mug's presence alone as progress.
node.binding: Compare the source and edited layouts relative to the headphones. Use visible object arrangement and any reliable continuity cues, but do not make color/scale matching or exact source-mug identity mandatory. State whether the right-side relation is newly achieved, whether there is clear movement toward it without achievement, or whether neither progress nor its absence is established.

dependencies.evidence: The edited image shows headphones near the center and a visible mug to their right. Another mug is to their left. The requested mug-to-right relation is visibly present.
